text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a software development practice where developers regularly merge their code changes into a shared repository. Each time code is added, automated builds run to check that everything works correctly. As part of this process, the system also runs tests to make sure new changes do not break existing features. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become bigger problems. CI pipelines are the tools that manage these steps automatically, from building to testing. By using Continuous Integration, teams can work faster, reduce mistakes, and deliver better software more reliably.
